note: Natural driving commands and what they must become (task 2026-09-28_natural-command). steps: [action, amount] after the validator - metres for forward/backward, degrees for turns. asks: true when the robot must ask instead of moving. goal: a place to go to - the words the parser must hand the map (the map resolves them). turns: a dialogue, the robot's questions answered in order. rules: false when only the LLM is expected to read it (free phrasing). intent: the step after which a purpose clause ('de tro ve ...') is met, null when none meets it. Used by test_drive.py (rules, offline) and test_live_parser.py (the configured LLM).
